mods.name: -BR- More Beautiful N'kari
mods.summary: Reworked N'Kari model with new textures, glowing eyes and an added voice pack.
mods.description:
Remakes N'Kari's look with a new model (made by LIG), reworked leather and armour textures in a more Slaanesh style, glowing eyes, a working jaw and a voice pack. Version 2.0 greatly reduced the file size and fixed textures.

On the Discord a player said they use it on N'Kari in the Alarielle, Temptation's Bloom campaign, so it is an optional look for that playthrough.

Slaanesh-style textures and glowing eyes
Voice pack
Reduced file size (2.0)
mods.recommendedFor: N'Kari players, e.g. in Alarielle, Temptation's Bloom, who want a different look for him.

mods.name: 2 Extra Building Slots for Major Settlements
mods.summary: Adds two building slots to every major settlement (provincial capitals), a deliberately modest increase compared with larger slot mods.
mods.description:
All provincial capitals get two extra building slots: most go from 8 to 10, special settlements such as Altdorf or Wood Elf forests from 10 to 12. The author made it because other slot mods add so many that they become overpowered.

The author lists it as compatible with Immortal Empires Expanded and Old World. It is a lighter alternative to bigger slot mods such as Casstiel's More Building Slots (2860265077).

It came up in the ATB channel as a mod someone was using.
mods.recommendedFor: Players who want a few more building slots without unbalancing the campaign.

steam.title: 2 Extra Building Slots for Major Settlements

relations.note: Listed as a required item on the Workshop page

openQuestions: Whether it should not be combined with other slot mods (not stated).

mods.name: 3D Porthole Lighting Fix
mods.summary: Adjusts colour and lighting of 3D character portholes to remove the blue-purple tint.
mods.description:
Changes colour and lighting values of 3D portholes so characters no longer look tinted blue and purple, landing between the Warhammer I and Warhammer II look. The values can be tweaked further with RPFM. CA improved portholes in patch 5.0, but the author keeps the mod updated for those who prefer it.

[LIG] Reskin - Neferata recommends it; its author says the reskin looks much better with this fix.
features: Removes the blue-purple tint in 3D portholes
Values adjustable with RPFM
mods.recommendedFor: Players of the [LIG] Neferata reskin, or anyone who dislikes the vanilla porthole lighting.

mods.name: [9.0.X] Dechala and Samael: The Denied Wedding
mods.summary: Story mod for Dechala's Immortal Empires campaign about her rivalry with the daemon prince Samael, ending in a final quest battle.
mods.description:
Adds a storyline to Dechala's Immortal Empires campaign. Samael returns with offers, poisoned gifts and growing manifestations, and Dechala can accept his help, defy him or turn his schemes against him. It ends in a trap-wedding: destroying Samael grants Dechala daemonic ascension and the power to raise her own lords to daemonhood, while binding him makes him a recruitable immortal Slaanesh lord.

The author's first mod, still in beta; it adds two quest battles. It needs the Tides of Torment DLC. Updated for 9.0.x. It was shared on the Discord as an interesting Slaanesh campaign add-on.
features: Samael storyline with choices in Dechala's IE campaign
Two extra quest battles
Daemonic ascension for Dechala or Samael as a recruitable lord
Updated for 9.0.x
mods.recommendedFor: Dechala players who want a story arc in Immortal Empires.

steam.title: [9.0.X] Dechala and Samael: The Denied Wedding

openQuestions: Compatible with Slaanesh Expanded (Vassal Dilemmas: Dechala fix) and other Dechala mods in the catalog?

mods.name: [9.0] Alarielle - wood elves campaign
mods.summary: Lets Alarielle's Avelorn faction use the Wood Elf forest-healing mechanic, with new forest buildings, landmarks and the Ancient Treeman lord.
mods.description:
Gives Alarielle's faction the Wood Elf campaign mechanic of healing the world's forests: worldroot travel between forests, the aspect system for her forest spirit units, forest buffs and a ritual that unlocks forest landmarks, plus the related encounters and dilemmas. New buildings include a 10-slot main building for magic forests; the Oak of Ages becomes a special High Elf building, and the Ancient Treeman lord joins her faction.

Do not play the Wood Elves with it (their mechanics break); other High Elf factions should be mostly fine. Mods that edit the Wood Elf scripts will not work with it. Updated for game version 9.0.

In the ATB channel it was mentioned as a dependency that might be needed.
features: Wood Elf forest-healing mechanic for Alarielle
Worldroot travel and aspect upgrades
Forest buildings and landmarks
Ancient Treeman lord for Avelorn
mods.recommendedFor: Alarielle players who want Wood Elf forest mechanics in her campaign.

relations.note: Listed as a required item on the Workshop page

installNotes: Do not play the Wood Elves while it is active.

mods.name: [9.x.x] Land Encounters And Points Of Interest - Events, Towers, Taverns, Boons & Curses + IEE + TOW
mods.summary: Standalone rework of Land Encounters: map spots with battles, treasure, towers, forges and taverns, plus lasting boons and curses for lords.
mods.description:
Fills the campaign map with points of interest: battle spots where you choose to fight or avoid, pre-battle offers, optional missions and rare battle modifiers, treasure, towers, forges and taverns. Most choices are trade-offs, and lords collect lasting boons and curses. Supports IEE and The Old World.

A standalone continuation of diagonal_zero's original; do not enable both. The latest rework needs a new campaign. On the Discord it was noted that Miao's Corrupting Alchemy can misbehave with mods that add special events.

mods.recommendedFor: Players who want more to do on the campaign map; check with Miao's Corrupting Alchemy.

mods.name: [Dark Elves]Black Ark Corsairs(Repeater Crossbows)
mods.summary: Adds a repeater crossbow variant to the Black Ark Corsairs.

openQuestions: Dependencies taken from the Steam description only.

mods.description:
According to the author, the Corsairs with repeater crossbows are meant to fill the gap between Darkshards and Shades. Their melee stats match the hand-bow variant, and their ranged attack matches the Darkshard bow with faster reloading; dual swords are deliberately not offered. The unit has a strength of 100 men.

It is recruited in the same building and at the same tier as the hand-bow variant and also appears as a garrison.

mods.name: [EN patch] The Coming of Winter: Katarin Faction Expansion
mods.summary: English patch for “The Coming of Winter”, a Katarin faction expansion that adds a Tzarina's Autocracy system with six agendas funded by prestige from battles.
mods.description:
English translation for a Chinese-made Katarin faction expansion. The base mod adds a “Tzarina's Autocracy” system: winning battles against the Ruinous Powers earns Prestige based on the value of the enemies killed, and Prestige advances six agendas with faction rewards.

Examples from the page: Diplomatic Ties (from alliances with non-Kislev factions) unlocks Empire reinforcements up to the Steam Tank and Land Ship; Ice Creed strengthens Ice Witches and Frost Maidens and grants a unique artifact at tier 4; Elevating the Guard strengthens guard units and allows on-the-spot recruitment of Armoured Kossars and Winged Lancers; Winter Invocation improves invocation rituals.

It is a non-lewd overhaul that came up in the Katarin channel as something to combine with Katarin corruption runs.
features: Tzarina's Autocracy system with six agendas
Prestige earned from battles against Chaos
Empire reinforcements, Ice Court and guard unit upgrades
mods.recommendedFor: Katarin players who want a deeper faction mechanic and play in English.

mods.description:
Endo's Bretonnia reskin depicts all non-hero Bretonnian units as women in stylised, impractical outfits; the author states there is no full nudity and tried to keep the themes accurate. It adds female voice audio, new unit cards and robust variants. For LOD issues the author suggests an LOD enhancer mod; the audio patch (Steam 3622829128) is needed when several of his reskins are used.

There are no changes to stats or gameplay and no dependencies; per the author the models should not add noticeable latency.

mods.name: [Endo] Combined Faction Reskins
mods.summary: Endo's female-replacer reskins combined in one pack: all non-hero humanoid units of several factions become female, plus selected heroes and lords, purely cosmetic.
mods.description:
Combines Endo's faction reskins into one pack. All humanoid non-hero units of the Empire, High Elves, Wood Elves, Bretonnia, Kislev, Cathay, Norsca and parts of Slaanesh become female, most in revealing outfits; the pack also includes the Slaanesh-themed variants and the hero and lord reskins up to the Ungors.

Only visuals change: no stats, skeletons, animations or gameplay. The page lists over 1,600 model variants, 550+ textures, new unit cards and infopics, custom audio and some edited loading screens, covering vanilla, Regiments of Renown and extended rosters.

It came up as the all-in-one alternative to installing Endo's single faction packs.
features: Female versions of all humanoid non-hero units for eight factions
Includes the Slaanesh variants and several hero and lord reskins
1,600+ model variants, new unit cards and audio
No gameplay changes
mods.recommendedFor: Players who want all of Endo's faction reskins without managing separate packs.

relations.note: The game allows only one merged soundbank, so Endo's combined pack and other audio mods cannot work together (Empire and Bretonnia units go silent).

Reworks the Grail Damsel models on top of the vanilla assets to make them look younger and prettier while staying close to the lore; facial geometry and UVs come from the original model. mods.description:
This modular submod adds extra buildings and units for the corrupted Miao Ying and Katarin. The base (**tdw_corrupted_buildings.pack**) brings many building chains tied to Miao's or Katarin's corruption stage: seven landmarks in wood elf territories, replacements for the defense and market buildings in Kislev and Cathay, recruitment chains for Norsca, beasts and Skinwolves, a Slaanesh temple building for Cathay (7 tiers) and more. Cathay players also get many of the Kislev buildings in Kislev territory.

Which units are added is up to you via optional add-on packs: Endo's Kislev reskins, MachineofCat's Forest of Debauchery units, Taraani's berserkers and amazons, a Slaangor hero with units, Zealots of Slaanesh and Warriors of Slaanesh (reskin or vanilla, not both). Another pack adds a building-based slave mechanic for Miao and Kat. Important: for the base you need either the Soil unit pack (Miao Corrupted Units) or the **_alt** variant without this dependency, never both.

The submod requires Lazy's Miao and Katarin progression as well as Mixu's Unlocker. For the add-on packs, the respective original mods must be active where the page says so. According to the author, the Slaangor pack may soon need adjusting, since the unit now exists in the base game. The page itself mentions that a more detailed description with images is still missing.

Slaanesh temple chain (7 tiers) for Cathay
Recruitment buildings for Kislev, Norsca and beast units
Optional unit packs (Endo, MachineofCat, Taraani, Zealots, Warriors of Slaanesh)
Optional building-based slave mechanic
Base available either with Soil units or as an _alt variant with vanilla units

mods.description:
Alarielle, Temptation's Bloom is a standalone story campaign for Alarielle, Queen of the Wood Elves, pitting her against the temptations of Slaanesh. The mod is part of Lazy Icarus' corruption ecosystem (Lazy's Progression Framework, MCT) and, according to the page, contains 48 scenes with texts and images from many contributors, the legendary heroine Vaeri, and around 170 dilemmas. The author warns that despite additional bonuses, the campaign deliberately contains traps: an easy victory as Alarielle is not intended.

Gameplay changes a lot: Alarielle's faction mechanics, rites, equipment and followers receive corrupted counterparts that are unlocked gradually. Corruption events open portals to the corrupted World Roots, and quest chains let you confederate Drycha, the Sisters of Twilight, N'Kari and Azazel. With Azazel (and therefore Miao Ying and Katarin), the mod is fully tied into Azazel's Realm, whose gameplay thereby becomes endgame content. The mod also changes the starting balance of the map (among other things, Valkia is removed and brought back for a late-game crisis; Miao Ying, Katarin, N'Kari, Tyrion and Eltharion are strengthened, several starting warlords are weakened) so that the quest chains are not destroyed by the AI and a strong Order bloc stands as the opponent at the end.

The themes are corruption and seduction by Slaanesh, depicted with explicit scenes (the page mentions tentacles, among other things). Since version 2.0 the story can also be played from the Slaanesh side (N'Kari, Dechala, Masque, Morathi, Azazel along with lords who confederate Azazel); the scenes stay the same. For a first playthrough the author recommends Alarielle (alternatively N'Kari or Morathi). The downloads include a LUA cheat sheet and a flowchart. If you only want the reskins, download just kerberos_mod_assets.pack and choose variants via Variant Selector.

Important: it only runs in Immortal Empires and Immortal Empires Expanded, and a new game is required. All required mods (Lazy's Framework including the Katarin/Miao progression, Corrupted Landmarks in the Workshop version, groovy_mct, Mixu's Unlocker, PJ Console with Context Viewer enabled, Azazel's Realm, Kerberos Mod Assets) should stay in the default order; some of the Steam items are unlisted and only linked from the LoversLab page. DLCs: The Queen & The Crone (Alarielle), Champions of Chaos (Azazel), Realm of the Wood Elves (Drycha), The Twisted & The Twilight (Sisters of Twilight). Corrupted Ascension, SFO, RDLL (only with AI recruitment disabled), Walk with the Dragon, Legendary Characters by Stratovarius and some UI mods are considered incompatible; do not play as Wood Elves with ATB active. The author links a recommended mod list with load order in the Lewdhammer wiki.

Full integration with Azazel's Realm (Miao Ying / Katarin as endgame)
Also playable from the Slaanesh side from v2.0 (N'Kari, Dechala, Masque, Morathi, Azazel)
MCT options for scene pacing; changed starting balance of the map

mods.description:
**Azazel's Realm** is a campaign expansion built on Lazy's corruption framework, with two quest chains: As **Azazel** (Slaanesh), you steer the fall of **Miao Ying** (Grand Cathay) and **Tzarina Katarin** (Kislev) into corruption, and in the end you decide whether they are confederated into your harem or remain autonomous as allies or vassals. As **Miao Ying** you play the other side: you can resist Azazel's seduction or succumb to it, and afterwards help convert Katarin as well.

The mod is fully integrated into Lazy's Miao and Katarin progression. According to the page, it also includes around 110 artworks (plus a video) by SOBORO, branching quest chains with multiple routes, three quest battles with voice acting and camera events, portals in Immortal Empires (opened by a corruption event), a quest to revive N'Kari's faction, and bonus scenes featuring Sigvald, Greasus and Yuan Bo, among others. According to the author, Azazel already has an easy campaign and will get even more tools; to compensate, traps have been built in that make the run more challenging.

**How to play:** As Miao, the content begins one turn after corruption level 2 of Lazy's Miao progression. As Azazel, you receive two quests on turn 2 (one per target). Archaon, Be'lakor, Sigvald and the Daemon Prince (Daemons of Chaos) confederate Azazel on turn 1 and play the same quests (full feature parity except for the Daemon Prince, who is not recommended). N'Kari and Morathi are now only supported together with *Alarielle, Temptation's Bloom*. There is no content for playing as Katarin - in that case, disable the mod (and Valkia).

**Important:** The mod changes the starting map significantly (among other things, Valkia is removed and brought back in a controlled way for the endgame crisis moment, and several factions are weakened, strengthened or confederated) so that Azazel, Miao and Katarin are not wiped out prematurely and a strong opponent is ready at the end. It only works in Immortal Empires and IE Expanded, ideally in a new campaign. The Steam items are unlisted and only linked from the LL page. The author insists on PJ's Console with the Context Viewer enabled; without this diagnostic information there is no support. For Miao, according to the author, either 'Slaanesh Assaults The Great Bastion' or 'Miao Ying vs Slaanesh (IE start positions)' is practically mandatory so that her corruption progresses naturally.

For incompatibilities (SFO, Recruit Defeated Legendary Lords, Corrupted Ascension, Just Good Battle UI, Helper UI and others), see the entry's relations and known issues. The download file also contains a LUA cheat sheet and a flowchart of both campaigns, as well as the optional file @@Compendium_Play_as_Azazel_Overwrite (only when playing as Azazel or as a faction that confederates Azazel; disable it when starting as Miao).
features: Two campaign quest chains: play as Azazel or as Miao Ying
Integration into Lazy's corruption progression for Miao and Katarin
Around 110 artworks and a video by SOBORO, some with voiced scenes
Three quest battles with voice acting and camera events
Branching routes: confederation or vassal/alliance ending
Portals in Immortal Empires between Miao and Azazel territory (via corruption event)
Quest to revive N'Kari's faction
Altered starting map; Valkia returns as an endgame crisis

mods.description:
Battle Angel XXX adds a standalone Legendary Hero named Hitomi, available to all factions and renamable in game. According to the author, it is essentially a rip of a Chinese Steam mod (the page uncertainly names “Shen Zuu”), whose mesh he edited to be considerably more revealing and cleaned of errors.

The character was heavily rebalanced and toned down: she is a duel specialist as a Light mage and a buffer for her immediate surroundings. The unit card and porthole are AI-generated. The backstory makes Hitomi a former concubine of the Celestial Dragon Emperor who fell to Slaanesh; his “blessing” made her bust grow enormously. Later she escaped to the Old World with a shield passed to her by Khorne, and now joins the player's lord.

The mod is standalone and requires a new game; it needs no other mod (checked in game). In custom battles she appears as “Crusader Angel” among Grand Cathay's lords.

Renamable in game

mods.description:
Corrupted Shenzoo is an early alpha campaign about Shen-zoo, the “Dragon of Light and Hope”, who is considered missing in the Realm of Chaos lore. You play it as your own faction under the Cathay banner, lost in the barren north, with the question of whether it finds its way home or succumbs to corruption.

Currently only a beginning is playable: finding a home, meeting the first companion and talking to them via a new faction mechanic, passing a custom quest battle (by Kerberos) and freeing a second companion. Planned or partly included are companion heroes (Leiyue, Dachi Shou, Loi, Zhang), random dilemmas, lewd traits with visible progress on the model (e.g. “Bickering” between companions) and an additional, corruptible tech tree.

Incompatible (main version only): Victory Condition Overhaul, 'Slaanesh Vassals', Recruit Defeated Legendary Lords, complete overhauls such as SFO. Testing by the author traced the final capture mission of the corrupted legendary lords failing to fire to Victory Condition Overhaul (the other two are suspects); with them disabled and Community Beastmen high in the load order it fires.

Main version is for Beastmen campaigns only: with another faction it can cause a script error at start, a missing rites/recruit button or lost skills, and it removes the mounts of female legendary lords and heroes of other factions on purpose (so the matched animations show). Since the game update of 2026-10-26: startup crash reported for some players on the Steam copy (one fix that worked: unsubscribe, delete the mod's pack from the Steam workshop/data folder, subscribe again), Ruination tier 1 building missing (db fix: change ruination 1 to 2), ritual of ruination not usable.

If it still crashes, spawn her with the console command from the GitHub guide (this does not complete the quest).

Steam copy can stay on an outdated version (it may even show an old date), then new content is missing or the game crashes; the full pack is roughly 1.6 GB. Unsubscribe, wait a couple of minutes, resubscribe and check that Steam really downloads the update.

Total Warmaidens reskins clash with units shared with this mod (Centigors of Tzeentch, Minotaurs, Chaos Spawn): both replace the same models, so some conflict cannot be avoided. Zeta's beastmen reskin (Beauty and Beasts) is not really compatible: both change the Minotaur skin and Community Beastmen wins regardless of load order. Zeta's faction-specific packs are fine.
Mods that add items or ancillaries (for example 'New Legendary Lord and Hero Artefacts', 'Just More Items') conflict with this mod's own auxiliary and item changes.
Under Tabletop Caps the units added by this mod (mercenaries, corrupted elves) count as basic units without a cap; no compatibility submod existed as of 2026-01-24.

Fixes appear first on LoversLab / Google Drive; the Steam copy is uploaded by a second person and lags behind, sometimes by months (in July 2026 the next Steam update was announced for August). Prefer the LoversLab files for the newest fixes.

The LoversLab download is a text file with links to the hosted files (Google Drive since 2025-12-28, Mega before). LoversLab does not notice when the hosted file changes, so re-download the text file or follow its links for every update.
Copies older than the 2026-09-26 update crash at startup on game patch 9.0; the Light version worked from day one.

The merged pack already contains the Sewrat ancillaries and add-on, Candles' ancillaries, Endo's matched combat for beastmen, the corrupted-heroes ancillaries, the corrupted elves and the model-fix packs. Loading the separate packs next to it fires dilemmas twice or brings back wrong unit cards (see the cleanup note).

Since the 2025-11-03 update the matched animations target all humanoid skeletons; without a reskin of the humanoids the scenes are male-on-male. For non-Beastmen campaigns the author recommends the Light version.

Variant Selector support is built in (since 2025-11-29): Lazy's progressive reskins (Katarin, Morathi, Miao Ying), the Kerberos variants (Alarielle, Sisters of Twilight, Ariel) and Khalida can be switched in game. The reskin mods themselves are still needed and must win the load order; reskins not built for Variant Selector may not apply to the hero versions.
Skill-tree reworks (Katarin and Miao Ying 2026-05-30, Fay 2026-06-06) can cost already spent skill points, so a respec may be needed; the author calls most other updates save compatible.
The author takes modding breaks (from 2026-09-26, again around 2026-10-18 and 2026-11-01), so open bugs can wait.

Two versions: new_community_beastmen.pack (Steam 3476784883 and LoversLab) only for Khazrak, Malagor, Taurox and Morghur campaigns; community_beastmen_light.pack (LoversLab only) with just the reskins and animations, for any faction. Endo's matched (sex) animations are part of the mod; they play on infantry on foot only, not on mounted or fleeing models and not for lord abilities. More Animation makes them happen more often.

mods.description:
A small submod that gives corrupted characters the “Seduce Units” mechanic of the Slaanesh factions: enemy units can be seduced and won over. There is one version each for Miao Ying (tdw_cth_seduce), Katarin (tdw_kat_seduce) and Morathi (tdw_mor_seduce).

Technically, the character's faction starts with a seduce budget of -200% so that other normal lords of the faction do not share the mechanic. From corruption level 3 (Morathi: level 2) the character receives a trait that unlocks a budget above zero and brings more budget and better effects with each further level. Other Legendary Lords with their own corruption mod or from Slaanesh factions (Morathi, Fay Enchantress, Katarin, Azazel, Sigvald, N'Kari) receive their own traits as soon as they are in Miao Ying's or Katarin's faction; Fay Enchantress, for example, makes seducing Bretonnians and other humans cheaper, and Morathi does the same for elves. Only membership counts, not how the lord joined.

The matching corruption mod is required in each case: Lazy's Miao Ying Progression plus Corrupted Compendium (the tutor there gives a small bonus and can now only be equipped by Miao), Lazy's Corrupted Katarin, or Lazy's Morathi Ascension. The mods for the other lords are not required but useful. The author states compatibility with his Easy Cross Faction Confederation scripts and explicitly recommends Keep Seduced Units (Steam), even though it makes the mechanic very strong.

mods.description:
**Corrupted Landmarks** adds a large number of additional landmarks to the game: 32 for Cathay, 30 for Kislev, 23 for Slaanesh, 12 for Warriors of Chaos, 16 for Dark Elves and 15 for High Elves (none for Daemons of Chaos, because their settlement mechanics don't fit). Cathay and Kislev landmarks are unlocked through the corruption stage of Lazy's Miao and Katarin progression respectively; according to the author, both progressions may be needed for the stage lock of the Miao/Kat landmarks.

In Cathay there is generic Slaanesh unit recruitment as well as hero recruitment (Alluresses, Chaos Sorcerers of Slaanesh) via the existing Slaanesh roster tables, so balance mods for Slaanesh units apply automatically. In Kislev you can recruit Slaanesh and Tzeentch cultists. For Warriors of Chaos, Gaen Vale, Tor Yvresse and Lothern become Dark Fortresses, and the landmarks are most useful for Azazel and Sigvald. The Dark Elf landmarks are spread across Ulthuan and Cathay (fitting Morathi, especially with the author's starting-position swap mod), and the High Elf landmarks are around Alarielle's start; according to the author, a dedicated Alarielle progression with stage unlocks is only planned for later.

**Important:** The mod is now on Steam (3474483873); the LL page serves only as a backup. Before subscribing, delete the old version in the data folder. The load order doesn't matter, and no mandatory dependencies are needed anymore; the mod checks itself whether Lazy's Miao/Kat mods are active. A game restart is required.

installNotes: The story and heroes are for Alarielle (Morathi support is only planned). Since the 2026-10-08 Steam release the lord and heroes also carry over if Alarielle is confederated by another ATB/AZR-eligible lord (Azazel, Archaon, Sigvald, N'Kari), and an AI Alarielle can progress the questline herself. To play DCH as Morathi, summon the heroes with the console.

DCH removes Alarielle's starting handmaiden Joespharilis (a custom version by another author) and Imrik's starting mage Mikaela and replaces them with its own unique hero versions; mods that edit those two characters may no longer apply.

While DCH or the Citadel of Dusk is active, Court Unity confederation is blocked for Imrik, Teclis, Eltharion and Tyrion; confederating gives Caledor, Saphery, the Citadel of Dusk or Tiranoc instead (a lord each when LHEC is installed). This is on purpose, agreed with the ATB author to stop cheesing ATB stage 4, and the author says the removal is permanent (2026-11-01); a special lord for Saphery is planned.

Citadel of Dusk (a playable faction with its own lord and hero) is also available as the standalone Steam item 3829276482 since 2026-10-29; the same content is built into DCH from the 2026-10-30 update, so the standalone item is not needed together with DCH.
The Citadel of Dusk lord and hero are spawned on turn 1: adding it to a running campaign does not give them, but it does not break the save either; summon them with console commands.

The 2026-10-30 update ('Choices Have Consequences') makes the mod explicit (adults only) and adds support for the ATB finale: Pulvis, Mikaela and Nicola confront Alarielle, and the choice leads to an extra Aliathra lord model (playable Aliathra needs LHEC; the quest chain exists only when played with ATB).

SFO: DCH only adds units, buildings and heroes, so it should work with SFO in theory, but SFO raises unit health, numbers and damage, so DCH units will be weak without a balance patch (untested, author 2026-10-19).

mods.description:
A small script pack by habus that lets any player faction confederate “cross-faction” via events with certain lords. If one of these lords has been the player's vassal for 20 to 25 turns (random value), an event appears: you can confederate, postpone the decision or decline altogether. For Katarin, Morathi, Yin-Yin and the Fay Enchantress there is a separate pack each with a random event image; the remaining packs use generic images, according to the page.

To get the lords as vassals in the first place, the author recommends “All Diplomatic Options” from Steam. Particulars: on confederation Morathi receives the model of corruption stage 4 (because the AI cannot raise the stages and, according to the author, a confederated Morathi cannot either); the Fay Enchantress keeps her corruption mechanic. With Azazel's Realm, according to the author, the Katarin, N'Kari and Azazel packs are not needed, but do no harm as long as you do not confederate in the dilemma. The mod also works with the Miao seduce mod.

Additionally, a bonus pack for Khalida is included (tdw_khalida_switch_skin): after 5 turns without a battle she wears her vanilla skin, in war the army receives a buff and Zeta's skin is used; for this you need one of Zeta's Khalida reskins. There is a merged bundle pack of all 12 confederation mods – use either this or the individual packs.
features: Confederation via event with Katarin, Morathi, Yin-Yin, Fay Enchantress and others
Event after 20–25 turns of vassalage (random); accept, postpone or decline
Bundle pack with all 12 confederation mods, savegame-compatible for switching
Bonus: Khalida skin switch (requires Zeta's reskin)
mods.recommendedFor: For campaigns in which you win Morathi, Katarin, Yin-Yin or the Fay Enchantress as a vassal and then want to absorb them, no matter which faction you play. For vassalising, a diplomacy mod such as All Diplomatic Options is helpful.

mods.description:
Elspeth 2026 Wombo-Combo is a reskin combo pack for Elspeth von Draken. By his own account, the author wanted a “sexy, but still mystical” Elspeth for his Franz campaign. Since the March 2026 version, nine variants are packed into one mod, switchable in game via the Variant Selector. There are three types with three variants each: young without visible nipples (like the Steam version), young with visible nipples and shorter cloak colours, and older, closer to the original and with shorter hair.

The pack combines the author's three earlier versions, three SFW variants by Schess (Steam) and three new variants; the Steam entry “Elspeth Reskin Combo” is therefore redundant. The parts come from the work of several modders (nun's wimple/scarf by LazyIcarus and others); the author stresses that he only assembled them himself. A legacy archive with the four old files is included for reference only and is not needed.

mods.description:
An unfinished corruption mod about **Eltharion** (Yvresse), built on Lazy's corruption framework (`!!li_progression_framework.pack`). The story revolves around the question of whether the 'Grim' is truly emotionless or merely a prisoner of his duties, and how he is turned into a servant of Slaanesh. Because of the faction's Witcher crossover content, Cavill, Mellindirei and Triss also play a role.

**Status according to the page:** Only stage 0 is largely finished. At the start of a new campaign you receive the mission to conquer Gronti Mingol; the mission leads to a quest battle at the Dragon Horn Mine (Eltharion meets a long-standing Slaanesh daemon who is corrupting the land, and is defeated and taken prisoner). Victory and completed battle objectives bring additional bonuses (including strong campaign buffs, details still in progress); the next section starts after a win as well as after a loss.

**Planned:** five stages (encounter, prisoner, brainwashing, decision, rebirth), after which Eltharion, in the service of Slaanesh, is meant to take prisoners from the ranks of the 'righteous' lords, who are 'worked on' in prison and absorbed into the faction. New quests, texts, models, traits, a personal skill line, new prison interactions and special stories with other Legendary Lords are planned for this; the announcement describes Eltharion as female after the transformation. The page is in Chinese/English (the latter machine-translated).

Who it's for: only for players who want to follow the development; not yet usable as a complete campaign.
features: Corruption story for Eltharion (Yvresse) on Lazy's framework
Stage 0 finished: mission 'Conquer Gronti Mingol' and quest battle at the Dragon Horn Mine

mods.description:
This reskin set swaps the appearance of **Ensign Loi** from PassingByPosts' Corrupted Compendium. There are seven variants (A, B, C, D, E, F and DD), which you pick based on the screenshots. You either download one of the individual pack files or the **all-in-one pack** (@@All_Loi_Variant_selector.pack), with which you can switch between the variants in the Variant Selector; in that case no individual packs are needed. The author also recommends the mod "Rotate All Lords and Heroes".

The pack must sit above the Corrupted Compendium in the load order, as shown in a screenshot on the page. It can be added, removed or swapped at any time in the middle of a campaign. Variants A to C use assets from HuaJS258's Slaanesh Corrupted Cathay Roster, D, E, F and DD use assets from Ashkaari's Blushing Moon Unit Replacer; the original mods are not needed. Mod managers therefore report a conflict with these originals, which can be ignored.

**Important:** The mod has moved to Steam (ID 3503458514). There, custom unit cards and 2D portraits for all seven variants are included as well, so the author recommends deleting the LL version and using the Steam version.

mods.name: Global Pcall Listener Fix 9.0.x
mods.summary: Restores the protected script listeners from before patch 9.0, so one mod's script error no longer silently switches off other mods that listen to the same event.
mods.description:
Since patch 9.0 the game runs script listeners without protection: when one mod's listener throws an error, the remaining listeners for that event are skipped, with no message on screen or in the log. This fix wraps every listener in a protected call again, so every mod's listener still runs, and the old red script-error message (naming the event and the failing file) comes back.

It changes no gameplay, stats or AI, only error handling; the author describes it as multiplayer safe because it is the code path the game used before 9.0.

MrDustV, the author of Dust's Corrupted Heroes, suggested it while troubleshooting DCH. Corruption progressions and campaign mods depend heavily on event listeners, so it is a sensible base for any script-heavy lewd setup.
features: Every script listener runs in a protected call again
Script errors show the event and the file that failed
No gameplay, stat or AI changes
Described by the author as multiplayer safe
mods.recommendedFor: Anyone running several script-heavy mods (corruption progressions, campaign mods) on patch 9.0 or later.

mods.description:
This submod for **Lord Hero Swap** is aimed at players who collect female Legendary Lords via confederation mods and then lead them as heroes in a shared army. The problem according to the author: their skills often only benefit troops that you don't have as another faction. The mod makes sure that no invested skill point is wasted and that the bonuses are usable by every faction.

Eight characters are covered: Alarielle, Elspeth von Drakken, Morathi, Miao Ying, Repanse de Lyonnesse, Tzarina Katarin, the Fay Enchantress and the Sisters of Twilight. Each receives an additional skill line (8 points) that, according to the author, thematically reflects her corruption or integration as a harem member, with flavour texts that match the bonus, plus a corruption node as a counterbalance. In addition, the vanilla skills of all 49 skill points were adjusted so that they have at least one faction-independent benefit (exception: sections with four options where three points are required, in which the fourth option may remain unchanged). Ancillaries, mounts and quest items work independently of faction; as a hero, Alarielle receives Greater Arcane Conduit.

On balance: strong but thematically conceived, some skills have drawbacks; bonuses add up when used together in one army (according to the author, Miao Ying is perhaps borderline). Banners are useless once the characters are heroes. Some quests only start at the beginning of the turn after reaching the level. The main package is '(X)_Hero_Swap_Harem.7z'.

There is also the optional file '(X)_Hero!Swap_HaremXtra.7z': it adds bullet points in crude language to unit cards and gives Miao, Morathi, Alarielle and Katarin corresponding epithets; it is best activated only after the first heroine has been converted. A Chinese translation is included as a separate file. The prerequisite is New Lord Hero Swap 9.0 (Unofficial Fix) or, for older saves, the original plus the fix mod.
features: Additional skill line (8 points) for eight female Legendary Lords as heroes
Vanilla skills of all 49 skill points with faction-independent benefits
Corruption node per character as a counterbalance
Ancillaries, mounts and quest items usable independently of faction
Optional Xtra package (unit card texts, epithets)
Chinese translation as a separate file
mods.recommendedFor: For profiles in which several female Legendary Lords are collected via confederation mods (e.g. Slaanesh Expanded, Recruit Defeated Legendary Lords, Alarielle, Temptation's Bloom) and turned into heroes of a harem army with Lord Hero Swap. Useless without Lord Hero Swap.

mods.description:
This is the central page for **Lazy's Miao Ying progression** and also the **progression framework** on which the Katarin and Morathi progressions are built as well. Each stage is its own mod (reskin plus game mechanics); without the framework the stages are pure reskins, with the framework they bring real gameplay changes. The framework must sit above the stage mods in the load order, otherwise a crash is likely. All files have been moved to Steam; the LL downloads only redirect to the Steam collection.

**Stages at a glance:** Stages 1 to 3 are purely mental (Miao becomes chattier, then provocative, then more adventurous up to humiliation and BDSM), accompanied by cursed high heels ("Heels of Protection", later "Heels of Depravation") that give more protection but reduce speed and can no longer be taken off. From stage 4, body modifications through piercings follow; in stages 5 and 6 a mutated mount binds itself to her spine, followed by further body changes, a tail, a daemonic arm and tentacles on the shoes. Stage 6+ adds a pregnancy/birth mechanic: she gradually loses her dragon form, Slaanesh's seal drains strength but her magical intensity rises, and depending on the trait level you can "give birth" to more weak or stronger units.

**Diplomacy mechanic ("Foreign Dickplomacy"):** From stage 2, repeated defeats against N'Kari leave effects on Miao; after four defeats in a row she is confederated or becomes a vassal. This only works with manually fought battles (autoresolve triggers nothing), and Miao does not die in the process. From stage 1 you can also gather progress purely through diplomacy: 20 points per stage, with a non-aggression pact or trade (+1 each), alliance (+2) or vassalage (+3) per turn, each counted at most once. In addition, "Corruption Adaptation" adjusts the balance based on corruption level and province corruption.

**Notes:** The theme is voluntary and later forced corruption with transformation and subjugation. Known issue: after a confederation, Miao's name disappears from the next turn on (no fix planned). For errors, the Lazy Discord helps (#faq, then #help) with li_log.txt and script_log (subscribe to the Lua Console mod for that).

Six corruption stages plus stage 6+ with a birth mechanic
Stages usable individually (pure reskins without the framework)
Diplomacy mechanic toward Slaanesh/Chaos factions, also playable as N'Kari
"Corruption Adaptation": balance depending on corruption level
Cursed shoes, piercings and mount mutation as story elements
Download via Steam collection

mods.description:
This page belongs to **Lazy's Morathi Ascension**: a gameplay-driven corruption and ascension progression for Morathi, split into individually loadable stage mods. With the progression framework (found on the Miao Ying page) there are real gameplay changes; without the framework the stages are pure reskins. All of the content is on Steam; the LL downloads redirect there. A progression guide, including the side progression via the Masque, is available on the Lewdhammer wiki.

In terms of gameplay, the progression relies on a quest chain. Early missions against Alith Anar and Malus were rebuilt as quest battles in January 2025 so that they also work when the opponents have been defeated or wounded. In addition, Alith Anar, Malus, Teclis and N'Kari get large AI bonuses while you play as Morathi, so that they are not wiped out too early and do not block the progression. Morathi serves as the playable character in the Cult of Pleasure.

**Things to note:** According to the author, the story is incomplete and was on hold for a while; work resumed in 2025. Since patch 6.0, Morathi's high heels sink into the ground in battle (unresolved animation problem). How far the story extends by now is not clear from the page.

mods.description:
Miao Ying's Corrupting Alchemy ports three familiar mechanics from other factions to Miao Ying's Cathay campaign: Grom's cauldron (alchemy), Eltharion's prison (here as “Jade Dungeon”) and Throt's flesh lab (here “Chamber of Excess”). Added to these are lord ascension, a separate recruitment list for “Blessed Units”, underground cults and two landmark story arcs.

Everything hinges on the corruption stages from Lazy's Miao Ying Progression: stage 1 unlocks the prison and lord corruption, stage 2 the cauldron (15 recipes, 25 ingredients) along with missions for the landmarks, stage 3 the flesh lab and the ascension of lords from rank 15 (Daemon Prince or Exalted Keeper of Secrets), stage 4 the cults beneath the settlements. Without Lazy's Progression the systems stay locked; without Soil's Corrupted Units, recipe transformations and ascension abilities do not work (warning in the log).

Thematically it is about Slaanesh corruption, prisoners (imprisoning, interrogating, “indoctrinating”), mutation/augmentation of units and the transformation of the Cathay lords. At the start, the neighbouring Imperial Wardens and Celestial Loyalists are replaced by two small Slaanesh migrant factions.

The mod is a playtest (the author asks for feedback; according to the page there are still UI inconsistencies and placeholder portraits) and requires the DLC “The Warden and the Paunch”. Because of the many new displays in the resource bar, the author additionally recommends UI mods against the crowding. According to the author it is compatible with SFO and Corrupted Landmarks. The page does not say whether a new campaign is needed – to be safe, start a new one when adding it.
features: Alchemy/cooking for Cathay: 15 recipes (5 of them secret), 25 ingredients
Jade Dungeon: take prisoners, execute, indoctrinate, interrogate, upgrade tiers
Chamber of Excess: Growth Vat, unit and monster augmentation, resource “Exquisite Ichor”
Lord ascension: Cathay lords turn into Slaanesh forms, and into daemons from rank 15
Blessed Units recruitment with 25+ unique units
Underground cults (Alchemist hero) with teleport between tier-5 cults
Two landmark arcs: corrupted Skaven and Ogres
Playtest state, requires the DLC “The Warden and the Paunch”

mods.name: More Animation
mods.summary: Battle setting tweak that makes matched-combat animations happen much more often. Adds no animations of its own; save-game compatible.
mods.description:
More Animation changes battle settings so that melee uses matched combat (paired, synchronised animations) far more often instead of separate attacks. The chance values for matched combat are raised to the maximum, the hit-point thresholds for starting and continuing a matched fight are lowered, and premature kills are removed so that the killing hit lines up with the death animation.

It does not add new animations, so it should stay compatible with mods that do. The author describes it as save-game compatible and compatible with everything. It is a general gameplay/visual tweak, not a lewd mod.

mods.description:
**Corrupted Valkia** (Alpha 0.8/0.81) tells the story of Valkia the Bloody's corruption through her cursed shield, which holds the soul and mind of the Slaaneshi daemon prince Locephax. A points system (starting at 105, in steps of 10) controls how her model changes depending on your playstyle: either toward Khorne or into the arms of Slaanesh. At release, 12 of the more than 20 planned model variants are playable, but only the Slaanesh path (author: EphasPassius) is implemented at its core; according to the page, the Khorne path (author: FriendlyKitteh) is not yet implemented.

**Start of the story:** At the beginning Valkia looks like she does in the base game, and you decide when the corruption begins. To do so, you have to retreat from a battle once in the pre-battle view, which triggers the first dilemma and the trait "Intrigue of the Dark Prince". After at least three turns, a second retreat triggers the second dilemma, after which Valkia is at stage N0 and the favor of the two gods can rise and fall. Later, randomly generated dilemmas, user-contributed events, lewd traits with visible model effects, custom skill trees (by Misao) and the Profane Hold near Kuark are added, through which you obtain Slaanesh units and heroes.

**Endgame (Slaanesh route):** After stage 6, the gods' favor loses importance; from S9 on, Khorne regards her as lost and sends a crisis against you. After that, you can let Locephax complete the betrayal (he takes over as lord and Valkia is subjugated) or refuse, whereupon N'Kari attacks with his hordes. The themes are corruption, subjugation and dominance, including pregnancy/lactation motifs in the traits.

**Notes:** The page warns that this version is highly experimental. The archive has to be unpacked before the pack goes into the data folder. The points total can so far only be viewed through the log file in the data folder; dilemmas triggered via console do not change the model, for that you have to change the tracking value. Hero characters such as Issath, Harald, Haelga and Kraghar as well as the Runesmith are not yet implemented.
features: Corruption points system with model changes (12 variants in the alpha)
Slaanesh path with an endgame decision; Khorne path not yet implemented
Dilemmas, random events and lewd traits with model effects
Custom skill trees; playable lord Locephax in the endgame
Profane Hold near Kuark as a source of Slaanesh units and heroes
Turns most major capitals into Dark Fortresses
Optional model selection via a variant selector GUI (cosmetic only)

It adds new building chains for handling corruption the way you want: an industry chain for trinkets that is about 10% better than the normal one and adds corruption, and a growth chain that is slightly better and also adds corruption, each with its own icon.

Gates get unique versions balanced for Slaanesh corruption, with custom garrisons that include heroes. High Elf gates and the Bastion gain spells, one of them a custom spell that combines Phantasmagoria and Lash of Pain. The Bastion's support building slots are unlocked with their own effects. Counting the chains, the mod adds over 28 buildings.

The Workshop page lists no required items. The KPW guides list it for Alarielle, Morathi, N'Kari and Azazel runs, and it appears in six Readman mod lists.
features: Industry (trinket) and growth building chains that add corruption
Unique gates with hero garrisons and spells
Unlocked Bastion support slots
Over 28 buildings in total
mods.recommendedFor: ATB runs that want more control over how corruption spreads through buildings.

mods.description:
An add-on for the Community Beastmen mod that integrates the Beastmen more strongly into its narrative framework. According to the page, only “the main mod Community Beastmen” is required, without naming the exact variant. Part 1 brings new skills (four per generic lord, two per hero) as well as new active abilities for certain lords and heroes.

Passive abilities are rewritten and renamed (example: Primal Fury becomes Primal Lust), and all skill images have been replaced. According to the author, the new skills and abilities give no additional strength in the autoresolve calculation; after testing he considers the mod reasonably balanced. Some of the images come from other artists (credits on the page) and are partly still to be replaced.

A part 2 is announced, centered on hunting female Legendary Lords: for each defeated lady there is a dilemma with a choice between a strong buff or corrupted items, with self-made cover images. This part is not yet included. Older versions can simply be replaced by the new one; after a CA table update the skill trees were temporarily broken, and the latest version is meant to fix that.

mods.description:
A collection of submods that add nudity to Sarvente's Cathay hero mods (and a few other Steam mods); for some heroes the balance is also reworked. The original Steam mods are required in each case, and the submods sit above them in the load order.

In detail: Mariko is stripped and significantly toned down (from “god-tier” to a specialized assassin or character killer, plus bug fixes and new unit cards). Enhi becomes a glass-cannon mage with regenerating shields who is quickly punished in melee. Xiao and Liu are undressed with no balance changes. The recruitable hero types Hakutaku Diviners, Shards of Dai Ji and Hollows get their own nudity variants (for Hollows only clothing removed, without details), plus a combined building pack and an Alt Hero package that bundles all three plus buildings. Taoyan is not a submod but a standalone, very revealing model. A bonus submod (@LK_dark) covers the all-faction lord Aelesha Sigrika and is not included in the all-in-one.

Practical notes: (X)_Cathay_ALL_XXX bundles everything except the bonus submod in one file; you can also pick individual heroes. According to the author, the load order is automatic, and all parts except Mariko can be added mid-save. A Chinese translation of the Sarvente heroes is available on Steam.

mods.name: Shenzoo: The Long March Home
mods.summary: Alpha faction mod by PassingbyPosts: play as Shenzoo, a new Cathayan legendary lord stranded in Norsca, in a story campaign about finding her way home.
mods.description:
Shenzoo, the youngest daughter of the Dragon Emperor, starts stranded on the Norscan coast after her fleet is wrecked while she chases a vision of an evil stirring in the west. You rally her scattered forces, make uneasy alliances and recruit former enemies on a long march back towards Cathay.

The mod adds Shenzoo as a new legendary lord with a unique campaign start, custom voice lines, a faction mechanic for talking to companions in a light-novel style, a narrative campaign and new battles. It is an alpha meant for feedback and bug hunting: Cathayan buildings are usable for now, but the final version is meant to keep you short of troops.

The Workshop page requires Mixu's Unlocker, MCT and Variant Selector. On Discord the story is described as running until Valkia is defeated and Loi is collected from the Compendium; a Russian version from 2026-06-04 exists and must be loaded above the original.

Requires Mixu's Unlocker, MCT and Variant Selector

Since 2026-09-26 the Steam item is unlisted because of adult content: it does not show up in Workshop search and is reached through its direct link only. The author also keeps a Mega copy for countries that block the Workshop.
The tech tree was changed in the 2026-05-22 release; the hero Hua Feng is part of the main release since 2026-05-11 (a separate Shenzoo_Hero_Hua_Feng.pack existed before).

mods.description:
**Slaanesh Expanded** adds short event chains that trigger when you defeat one of the female Legendary Lords. There are three tiers per lord. Each tier grants traits that raise Slaanesh corruption on the defeated lord and thus offset her natural anti-corruption (for example Alarielle's "Power of Nature" or Miao Ying's faction-wide −2 corruption). The corruption strength is tuned individually for each lord.

It is triggered by a victory with any army of your faction, played or autoresolved, with no cooldown. If the lord becomes a vassal or is confederated, the events continue with plainer texts at the start of each turn. At tier 3 you can accept or decline a "Harem" trait that improves Slaanesh corruption and diplomatic relations between the supported factions faction-wide; the bonuses are tuned so that the lord remains a vassal. Supported are Alarielle, Elspeth, Fay Enchantress, Hellebron, Katarin, Miao Ying, Morathi, Repanse, Sisters of Twilight and Khalida. The mod is intended for Slaanesh factions, but according to the author works with any faction.

The optional **confederation submod** (requires the main mod) counts victories per lord and, while she is a vassal, one point per turn. From eight points you are asked whether you want to confederate her or leave her as a vassal. Compatibility: the defeat events currently do not apply to characters with multiple corruption stages such as Lazy's Miao or Katarin; vassal and confederation events still work there. The artwork is by SOBORO.

mods.description:
The mod adds **dilemmas** that appear when the player subjugates a female Legendary Lord - via vassalization or confederation. There are two versions: one that is only active for Slaanesh factions (N'Kari, Azazel, Sigvald), and one for all other factions (also, at the community's request, for the female lords themselves). Both can be used in parallel. All artworks are by SOBORO.

**Mechanics:** After the first subjugated lord, the base chance of a dilemma is 35% per turn; each subjugated female lord raises it by 5% (as a symbol of growing Slaanesh corruption). If no dilemma occurs, the chance increases turn by turn until one appears. The options are rewards: Slaanesh factions receive or trade Devotees or Souls (including for a random ancillary or a great gift of Slaanesh), other factions receive +10% army replenishment for one turn, 1,000 gold, or can spend gold on an ancillary or a great gift.

**Supported** are Alarielle, Elspeth, Fay Enchantress, Hellebron, Katarin, Miao Ying, Morathi, Repanse and the Sisters of Twilight (1-4 dilemmas each) as well as two shared dilemmas (Alarielle + Morathi, Katarin + Miao Ying). The mod does not provide confederation itself; it only reacts to it. The author additionally recommends 'Trade Any Settlement'; according to the page, 'No Confederation - All Factions' did not work in late 2024 and crashed.

mods.description:
Soil's Corrupted Units is a collection of corrupted unit mods for various factions, intended as a complement to other corruption mods. The units are obtained via warband upgrades. You always need two files: the asset pack and the mod for the faction you are currently playing (only that one each).

The new Miao Ying mod brings a complete corruption roster with a different playstyle (supporting ranged units and melee damage dealers), an additional tech tree, warband upgrades for converting normal units, a scaling malus on standard units (to force the switch), and corrupted main, military and economy buildings. It requires Li's Miao Ying corruption mods; the asset file must be updated for this. The Azazel mod requires Kerberos' Azazel's Realm and must be loaded after it.

Anything that changes the warband upgrades of the faction being played is incompatible (according to the author, mostly only visually). A community fix replaces the asset pack because new textures otherwise partly overwrite standard Cathay units.
features: Corrupted units via warband upgrades
Miao Ying: complete corruption roster, tech tree, corrupted buildings
Scaling malus on standard units forces the switch
Azazel version builds on Azazel's Realm
Asset pack plus one faction mod required
mods.recommendedFor: For profiles with Lazy's Miao Ying corruption or Azazel's Realm that want their own corrupted roster and buildings. Load only the mod for the faction you play; replace the asset pack with the fix version (ll-48415) if needed.

mods.description:
This mod gives Miao Ying's faction a set of Slaanesh and Tzeentch daemon units with tech upgrades, intended for roleplaying the corrupted Miao Ying alongside Lazy's Corrupted Miao Ying Progression. The units are available only to Miao Ying's faction and, according to the author, are not tied to the progression system: you are supposed to build them yourself only once the corruption has advanced far enough.

Included are, among others, Slaanesh Marauders, Hellstriders, Seekers, Chosen, Keeper of Secrets, Fiends and Daemonettes (also Exalted) as well as Tzeentch Chosen, Horrors, Chaos Knights, Spawn, Screamers, Flamers, Soul Grinder and more. The tech upgrades are stronger than the base upgrades because daemon units use neither lord skills nor Harmony. With the Dragon Emperor's blessing all units get 69 barrier, according to the page. The author points out that the mod is not balanced.

mods.name: The Cult of Slaanesh
mods.summary: Turns Morathi's Cult of Pleasure and related Dark Elf factions into a Slaanesh-devoted faction modelled on Storm of Chaos: Slaanesh magic and daemons in, Khaine units out.
mods.description:

mods.summary: Political intrigue system for the High Elves based on the Tower of Zharr mechanic: the ten kingdoms of Ulthuan compete for seats of authority.
mods.description:
Adds a court-politics system to the High Elves, built on the Chaos Dwarf Tower of Zharr mechanic but going well beyond it. Each of the ten kingdoms of Ulthuan has its own strengths and goals; factions compete for seats with thematic effects, and buildings, edicts, traits, technologies, rituals and post-battle options feed into it. For balance, the court blocks normal diplomatic confederation for the High Elves.

In the ATB channel it was reported to work alongside Alarielle, Temptation's Bloom, although its events do not perfectly match that mod's story.

mods.description:
The add-on extends **Endo's Goblin Hordes** with additional slave and prisoner content for Greenskins. After battles, female prisoners can drop as ancillaries depending on the enemy's culture (three per culture, five for the Empire, seven for the Dwarfs; Skaven and Greenskins drop nothing). According to the page, the drop rate is 15% for normal factions and 10% for Dwarfs. In addition, enemies can be captured in battles and when looting, in order to improve the new slave units with their own upgrades.

There are also more random dilemmas (still under construction), a new lord, the **Goblin Enslaver**, who is weaker than normal lords but gets army buffs for goblin slave units, bodyguards and mounts, as well as smaller changes: Cathay slaves are back as scout cavalry, prisoner pens give faction bonuses, and the cavalry was rebalanced.

**Important:** According to the author, the mod was broken by a CA update (and by Endo's mod); the author has given up Warhammer modding and releases the mod for others to continue with credit. The page points to a possible updated version, which is untested. Known problems: the mount swap does not change the campaign map model, the balancing is unfinished, and there may be overlaps with a newer goblin faction with its own prisoner resource. Put the newest version in the data folder and delete older ones.

mods.description:
A collection of **SFO adjustments** (stat overhaul mod) for several corruption and unit mods. All parts align stats and units with SFO:

- **Soil's Corrupted Units (standalone):** Chaos and Vampire units use their SFO counterparts, Bestigors are replaced by SFO Slaangors, and Soil's own units (cultists, Toxic Rocket/Cannon, Corrupted Dragon and others) take over the stats of comparable SFO units. The original does not need to be active.
- **Ensign Loi (Corrupted Compendium):** She now supplies allied armies with replenishment or training, attacks units and garrisons, and spreads public order; the skill display and names were reworked and stats adjusted.
- **SEU 'First Daughter / Last Shugengan':** Health set to 10,000 for heroes and lords, melee stats adjusted, dragon form with SFO Chaos Dragon stats.
- **Corrupted Ascension (Corruption Ascend 1.2):** Unit health at SFO level, adjustments for the Miao transformation and Katarin's Kholek form, among others.

There is also a small patch for [SFO] Double Skill Points (skill dump) and a pointer to 'No Corruption Reduction for SFO's new Miao Mechanic' as a separate page. Each part requires the corresponding original mod or SFO; the page lists the dependencies per part.
features: Soil's Corrupted Units on SFO stats (standalone)
Ensign Loi (Corrupted Compendium): reworked abilities and SFO stats
SEU First Daughter / Last Shugengan: SFO balance
Corrupted Ascension: unit stats at SFO level
Small patch for [SFO] Double Skill Points
mods.recommendedFor: Only for profiles that use SFO and at the same time use Soil's Corrupted Units, the Corrupted Compendium, SEU's First Daughter/Last Shugengan or Corrupted Ascension. Not useful without SFO. Note: Corrupted Ascension is incompatible with Lazy's framework.

mods.name: Where's My Blue Line? - Chaos Subculture Fix
mods.summary: Fixes missing blue campaign skill lines for confederated Chaos lords under non-Chaos factions by making the mono-god variant the default line. Also repairs a bug in Alarielle, Temptation's Bloom caused by version 9.x.

relations.note: Fixes a bug with Alarielle, Temptation's Bloom (Dechala, Ku'gath, Kairos, Generic Tzeentch from 9.x)

installNotes: Works with game versions 8.* and 9.*.
Affects mods that confederate Chaos factions as a non-Chaos faction.
Also restores the missing blue-line skills of Alarielle's snake form after game patch 9.0 (a CA change affecting confederated Chaos subcultures).
mods.description:
Fixes a problem with mods that confederate Chaos lords as a **non-Chaos faction**: the newly added lords often lack the blue skill line (campaign skills). According to the author, the cause is that CA defines one skill line each for Warriors/Daemons of Chaos and for the mono-god factions, and none at all for all other factions.

The mod does three things: (1) The mono-god variant of the blue line becomes the default line for all factions except Warriors of Chaos; (2) the mono-god-aligned Warriors of Chaos lords (Valkia, Festus, Vilitch, Azazel, Sigvald) use this variant under non-Warriors factions instead of the unusable '+Souls' skills; (3) it reverts a change from version 9.x that had made the line incompletely subculture-specific for Dechala, Ku'gath, Kairos and Generic Tzeentch - this fixes a bug in *Alarielle, Temptation's Bloom*.

Works with game versions 8.* and 9.*. Before/after images are in the gallery.
features: Default skill line (mono-god variant) for confederated Chaos lords under foreign factions
Valkia, Festus, Vilitch, Azazel, Sigvald receive a usable blue line
Fixes the 9.x bug for Dechala, Ku'gath, Kairos, Generic Tzeentch
Fix for Alarielle, Temptation's Bloom
Compatible with game versions 8.* and 9.*
mods.recommendedFor: For profiles with Alarielle, Temptation's Bloom or other mods that confederate Chaos lords as a non-Chaos faction; fixes missing campaign skills.

mods.description:
Corrupted Ascension (堕落升魔) is a corruption campaign for Miao Ying based on the Generic Framework (Steam, required). The page is exclusively in Chinese, and campaign or DLC details are missing. Start: Miao Ying's faction receives the artifact quest “Sword of Slaanesh” at the beginning of the game; completing it starts the path of corruption.

Core mechanics: Slaanesh's entourage grows with Miao's actions and is used to expand pleasure palaces and unlock power, among other things to upgrade normal troops into servants of Slaanesh and to let lords and heroes rise along a path of glory. Slaanesh's hegemony arises mainly from the pleasure palaces and unlocks campaign bonuses, traits and artifacts; at level 6 Miao receives daemon form and the ability to spawn daemon princes. The palaces and special landmarks in Cathay provide higher-tier troops or strong economic buildings.

If you play another faction, the AI Miao progresses automatically; the player gets event messages, and from level 6 (“Slaanesh Empire”) an event appears calling for Miao's defeat. Afterwards you can confederate her or make her faction a vassal. Important: the Alarielle page (ll-42028) declares the mod incompatible with anything based on Lazy's Framework.
features: Corruption progression for Miao Ying (quest “Sword of Slaanesh”)
Slaanesh entourage: troop upgrades and path of glory for lords and heroes
Slaanesh hegemony: bonuses, traits, artifacts, daemon form from level 6
Pleasure palaces and landmarks as a building line
AI Miao progresses automatically, final event with confederation or vassalization
Requires the Generic Framework (Steam)

notes.text: Higher in the list = loaded later and wins. Order per the wiki: !!li_progression_framework at the top, then the progression stages of individual characters, then the reskins. Visual submods that change reskins go above the reskins.
Every reskin stage ships its own campaign portrait; the game shows the one from the topmost reskin mod for that character.
Subscribe to Steam mods; after updates, re-subscribing is sometimes the only fix because Steam handles frequent updates badly. LL downloads (.pack) go into the game's data folder.

Remove the -dx11 launch option. Disable submods right after a game update. For help in Discord #help, post li_log.txt (mandatory) and script_log_*.txt from the game folder; script_log is only written with the Lua debug mod (Steam 2791799449).

Discord: live community, quick updates, niche submods. Steam collection 3472332568: the main downloads including framework, progression and reskins. LoversLab: some downloads, submods, preview images.

Steam's own launcher does not order mods. Use a mod manager and put MCT at the very top, then Lazy's progression framework, then the individual progression mods. Reskins may sit above the progression mods; submods go below the progression stages. Do not build a custom load order for ATB/AZR; follow the author's list.

Several mods moved from LoversLab to Steam (ATB, Azazel's Realm, Corrupted Landmarks, Corrupted Valkia, Corrupted Compendium, Corrupted Ascension). An old .pack with the same name left in the data folder takes priority over the Workshop copy and causes crashes or duplicate events. A Steam mod shown with a red name in the launcher is the usual sign.

Steam delivers updates of these mods late. If something breaks, re-subscribe or delete the local copy of Corrupted Landmarks, Readman CCC/TTT, Kerberos mod assets and ATB, and keep ATB, AZR, Corrupted Landmarks and the asset pack on matching versions. Turn submods off right after a game patch.

Incompatible with the progression framework: Zoat Elder - Generic Lord for Wood Elves (Steam 2855365665) and Preytons (Steam 2876531798). Legendary Lore does not work with Corrupted Compendium. Corrupted Ascension is incompatible with campaigns built on Lazy's framework; its Generic Framework, Corrupted Drycha and the Lin AllInOne translation do run alongside it.

Readman's mod lists come in early-game and late-game versions. Always start a campaign with the early-game list and switch only at the stated corruption stage (Alarielle: stage 5, Miao Ying: stage 4); starting with a late-game list breaks buildings on turn 1. Major updates of ATB/AZR need a new campaign.

On Lazy's Discord (https://discord.com/invite/lazyicarus) under 'Channels & Roles' you can subscribe to roles for update pings: 'Kerberos's Projects' (Alarielle, Azazel's Realm, ...) and 'Soil's projects' (Soil's Corrupted Units). Bugs for Lazy submods (e.g. the Soboro Miao reskin) are reported there; there are support channels per submod.
Kerberos 2 additionally runs their own Discord: https://discord.gg/W4qkrNwUMk (link on the Alarielle page).

Many lewd mods (Alarielle, Azazel's Realm, Kerberos Mod Assets, Readman submods, Lazy's Morathi) are 'unlisted' on Steam and reachable only via links on the LL page. Where nudity mods are region-blocked, Windows+R -> 'steam://openurl/<workshop-link>' helps.

Script errors appear in red at the top left; search script_log_###.txt in the WH3 folder for 'BIG FAT SCRIPT ERROR'. Kerberos_mod_log.txt shows in turn 1 whether the Alarielle/Azazel mod has started. Without these screenshots there is no support.

notes.topic: Framework families: Lazy vs. Generic Framework
notes.text: Two separate framework families: (1) Lazy's Corruption Framework (Steam 3464018577 or bundle 3472332568; basis for the Miao/Katarin/Morathi progression, Alarielle, Azazel's Realm). (2) Generic Framework (通用框架, Steam 3376886102) by 混沌破龍斩 for Corrupted Ascension, Corrupted Drycha, Summon Servant. According to the Alarielle page, Corrupted Ascension is incompatible with anything on Lazy's Framework (Habu-style 'tdw_*' and Kerberos mods).

Habu's tdw_corrupted_buildings* mods are meant for Miao. Disable them when playing as Alarielle (script errors, no benefit); use Kerberos' Steam version 'Corrupted Wood Elf Units for Slaanesh' (3566849815) instead. The Korean variant of the list partly contradicts this.

Recommended: @n_SlaaneshVictories.pack and @n_SlaaneshVassals_Non_Slaanesh_Factions.pack (script support in the mod). Do NOT use n_SlaaneshVictories_Confederations. Slaanesh Victories events only kick in from Alarielle corruption level 5+.

Useful from corruption level 5: Slaanesh UI theme (3304325611), Readman Late Lavish Looks (3528693285), flags (ll-41124 or Readman HD 3536009143). The Slaanesh UI theme needs Unique Faction UI (2789999718).

Soil's Corrupted Units (ll-32374) needs the asset pack + a faction-specific mod. ll-48415 is a community replacement for the asset pack (fixes overwriting of vanilla Cathay units). The Azazel version must sit above Azazel's Realm.
Dwjliel (Sexy Cathay Heroes Collection etc.): 'Load order should be automatic, but sub-mods obviously go above their parents.' Submods sit above the Steam parent mods.

The Discord invite link discord.gg/W4qkrNwUMk or discord.com/invite/W4qkrNwUMk (also discord.com/invite/lazyicarus) leads to the Lazy Icarus server; it hosts support channels for Kerberos mods (e.g. 'azazel-realm') and Community Beastmen. Subscribe to the role 'Kerberos's Projects' under 'Channels & Roles' for update pings. The Steam items of many mods are unlisted and only linked from their LL pages.

Before support requests, install PJ's Console (Console Commands, Steam 2791241084) and enable 'Enable context viewer' so that script errors appear as red text. Log: script_log_###.txt in the game directory; search for 'BIG FAT SCRIPT ERROR'. Kerberos mods write Kerberos_mod_log.txt, Lazy's framework writes li_log.txt.

Recommended complete mod list and load order for playing Miao/Azazel/Alarielle/Katarin: https://lewdhammer.miraheze.org/wiki/File:Mod_list_and_load_order.png (image, linked by the Kerberos author as a reference).

notes.topic: Miao Ying mods build on the Lazy framework
notes.text: Miao Ying's Corrupting Alchemy expects the following in the mod manager (top->bottom): Lazy's Corruption Framework, Soil Corrupted Units, MCT, Lazy's Miao Progression, miao-assets, miao, optionally Corrupted Compendium, Soil Assets. Without Lazy's Progression the mechanics stay locked.
According to the author, the Chinese Handmaiden translation (death13x) must not be uploaded to Steam and is only available in the LL translation section and on 3DM.

Central support server for the Lazy corruption ecosystem: invite https://discord.gg/W4qkrNwUMk (alternatively https://discord.com/invite/lazyicarus). For errors, first read #faq, then post in #help; requires li_log.txt (generated automatically in the game folder) and the current script_log_xxx.txt (needs the Lua Console mod, Steam 2791799449, before loading a save). The authors Rat of the Lake (#lake-tales) and Kerberos use the same server; role 'Kerberos's Azazel Realm' under 'Channels & Roles' gives update pings.

Lazy's progression framework sits above the stage/reskin mods (mod list: framework first, otherwise CTD). Stage mods can be used individually; without the framework they are pure reskins, with the framework the gameplay changes come in. The LL pages for Miao (23878), Morathi (23925) and Katarin (23966) now only redirect to Steam Workshop items (the Workshop version is called !li_progression_framework_workshop, formerly !!li_progression_framework.pack, 'name may change'). The framework is described on the Miao page (page: 'Framework for gameplay progressive corruption of Miao Ying'). Other mods that set 'requires li mod' (e.g. Corrupted Landmarks, Additional corrupted Buildings) depend on it.

Progression guides and framework documentation for Lazy's mods: https://lewdhammer.miraheze.org/wiki/Lewdhammer_Wiki ; pages 'Morathi', 'Morathi_Lore#Masque_Side_Progression', 'Katarin', 'How_to_use_Progression_Framework#Usage' (for modders).
With Lazy's mods, the topmost reskin in the load order determines which campaign image appears (Miao).

Russian translation packs (e.g. Community Beastmen, LL 43659) belong ABOVE the original in the mod list (higher priority = loads later). For the Alarielle translation (LL 43740), the instruction reads 'before the main mod' (ambiguous).

For Valkia (LL 24004), the Variant Selector should be below Valkia in the mod order; for Ensign Loi reskins (LL 27230), the reskin must be above the Corrupted Compendium. Mod managers show a harmless asset conflict with HuaJS258's Cathay Roster or Blushing Moon for the Loi variants.

Kerberos only enables flags/loading screens (LL 41124) and the 'Slaanesh UI theme' (Steam 3304325611) from corruption stage 4 (Miao) or stage 5 (Alarielle, Temptation's Bloom); otherwise duplicate UI elements are possible in the Alarielle mod.

presets.description:
The full **Alarielle, Temptation's Bloom (ATB)** story campaign as Readman plays it: Alarielle resists or gives in to Slaanesh's temptations while Kerberos' quest chains let her confederate Drycha, the Sisters of Twilight, N'Kari and eventually Azazel, which ties into **Azazel's Realm** and the Miao Ying / Katarin storylines.

On top of the shared base (Lazy's framework, Miao and Katarin progression, Corrupted Landmarks, MCT, quality-of-life mods) this list adds Readman's Alarielle packs: lewd buildings (BBB), Slaaneshi units (CCC), a corrupted tech tree (TTT) and the handmaiden ascension mechanic (UUU), plus Narok's Slaanesh Expanded dilemmas, Lin's Corrupted Drycha (with Generic Framework and the English translation) and a few legendary heroes (Lyra, Nymeria, LHEC).

**How to play:** start a new Immortal Empires campaign as Alarielle with this list and keep it until corruption stage 4. From stage 5, switch to *Alarielle – late game*. Do not reorder the list; the author supports only this order.

Readman BBB, CCC, TTT, UUU: buildings, units, tech tree, handmaiden ascension
Leads into Azazel's Realm and the Miao Ying / Katarin storylines
Immortal Empires only; needs The Queen & The Crone, Realm of the Wood Elves, Champions of Chaos and The Twisted & The Twilight for the full roster

tips.text: Slaanesh Expanded - Vassal Dilemmas counts Elspeth von Draken as vassalized or confederated from the start. On about every second or third turn (30 % chance, 5 % more for each turn without one, at most one a turn) a dilemma about Elspeth von Draken offers: +10 % replenishment for all your armies for a turn, 1,000 gold, a random ancillary for 3,000 gold, or Slaanesh's Blade and a Personal Sycophant for 25,000 gold. It has no downside; its texts are explicit.

Slaanesh Expanded - Corruption & Confederation counts Elspeth von Draken as won over from the start. On your first three turns an event each gives Elspeth von Draken a trait: +2, then +4, then +6 Slaanesh corruption in Elspeth von Draken's province (the levels replace each other). On turn 3, "Corrupt their kingdom" also gives Slaanesh's Harem: +8 Slaanesh corruption in all your provinces and +150 relations with the factions of the other ladies it knows; "Corrupt their soul" adds nothing more. Corruption costs public order, so take "Corrupt their soul" if you do not want it.

tips.text: Slaanesh Expanded - Vassal Dilemmas counts Repanse de Lyonesse as vassalized or confederated from the start. On about every second or third turn (30 % chance, 5 % more for each turn without one, at most one a turn) a dilemma about Repanse de Lyonesse offers: +10 % replenishment for all your armies for a turn, 1,000 gold, a random ancillary for 3,000 gold, or Slaanesh's Blade and a Personal Sycophant for 25,000 gold. It has no downside; its texts are explicit.

Slaanesh Expanded - Corruption & Confederation counts Repanse de Lyonesse as won over from the start. On your first three turns an event each gives Repanse de Lyonesse a trait: +2, then +4, then +6 Slaanesh corruption in Repanse de Lyonesse's province (the levels replace each other). On turn 3, "Corrupt their kingdom" also gives Slaanesh's Harem: +8 Slaanesh corruption in all your provinces and +150 relations with the factions of the other ladies it knows; "Corrupt their soul" adds nothing more. Corruption costs public order, so take "Corrupt their soul" if you do not want it.
